text.p: Romanian customs have seized 5.5 kg (12 pounds) of heroin worth hundreds of thousands of dollars near the Hungarian border and arrested two men, a senior officer said on Wednesday.
Colonel Petru Anghel, from Arad county, told national radio a sniffer dog had alerted them to the drugs, hidden under the seat of a car.
Anghel said the heroin was intended for western Europe, but did not specify its origin. He put the street value of the haul at several hundred thousand dollars.

According to local media a gram of heroin is sold for 120,000 lei ($20) on Bucharest streets. Police believe most drugs in the country are in transit on the "Balkan route" to the West, as domestic consumption is still low.
